title: A test-run wait reports a run `recover` settled as interrupted as "UNKNOWN (process gone)", "Interrupted: no", and suggests recover again
outcome: When a waited run's launcher died and `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs recover` settled it, termal_resume_after_test_runs reports it from the settled results.json: Interrupted: yes, its exit code (1), ended at the recovery time, with no suggestion to recover again.
acceptance: A test registers a wait on a run, kills its launcher, settles it with `recover`, and shows the wait's resume report reads the settled result: Interrupted yes, exit 1, the recovery time as its end, and no 'recover' suggestion.
A run whose process is gone and that nothing has settled still reports UNKNOWN (process gone) with the recover suggestion, so the report tells the two cases apart.
The full five-stage gate passes on the reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher.
